_comment: Fill in every value below, then update the matching placeholders in workflow.json

google_sheets._how_to_find: Open your Google Sheet → copy the long ID from the URL between /d/ and /edit

gmail._note: Replace user@example.com in workflow.json node 'Send Daily Summary Email' → sendTo

openai._how_to_get_key: platform.openai.com → API keys → Create new secret key

decodo._how_to_get_key: app.decodo.com → API → Scraping API → Get API Key

fit_score_filter._where_to_change: workflow.json → node 'Filter High Fit Jobs' → parameters.conditions.number[0].value2

schedule._meaning: Runs every day at 8:00 AM UTC
